desc: Analyze problem requirements and alkane structure (tree with degrees 1 or 4, at least one degree 4).
Derive algorithm: Root tree, compute max path length down (`down[u]`) and up (`up[u]`) for each node.
Formulate candidate calculation: For each node, collect branch lengths from all neighbors, pick top 4, sum + 1.
Implement the solution: Read input, build adjacency list, perform two DFS passes (down and up) to compute branch lengths, then iterate to find the maximum alkane size.
Handle edge cases (N < 5, no degree 4 nodes possible).
Optimize the Up DP calculation to be strictly $O(N)$ by using top-2 values.
